note: All scoring rules (columns, hard_constraints, objective, robustness, backward, local_trends) are inherited from configs/frontier_v1.json at load time. Do not duplicate them here.

secondary_benchmarks.named_chemistry: build with --no-anonymize to test performance with domain priors; never the primary result

candidate_space: WO2018173768-inspired PPG/4,4-MDI constrained grid (PUR_SIM_V1, synthetic; 58 blends x 16 NCO:OH points = 928 candidates)

uncertainty.rationale: PUR_SIM_V1 stores viscosity uncertainty as log10(eta) +/- r. For eta80/eta120, conservative rectangular propagation gives log10(ratio) +/- 2r because numerator and denominator can move in opposite directions.

layers.L0_property: argmin nominal property_score over all 928 candidates; no feasibility constraints
layers.L1_constrained: argmin nominal property_score over candidates passing point-response preferred/broad windows, NCO:OH, MDI fraction and chemistry-domain gates; uncertainty is intentionally not used at L1
layers.L2_robust: among L1 candidates whose propagated full uncertainty intervals remain inside the broad functional windows and domain_ratio <= 1.0, minimize the exact worst-case value of the same frozen log-space objective

robustness.definition: robust_score = sum_k w_k * (abs(log10(y_k/c_k)) + q_k*r)^2, with q_eta80=q_eta120=1 and q_ratio=2; this is the exact worst case of the nominal objective over the frozen rectangular log-space interval
robustness.rationale: Preferred windows define the optimization target, not a certification envelope. Full preferred-window containment gives zero robust candidates in this frozen space and is therefore not used. Broad windows are retained as the functional admissibility envelope under uncertainty; within that admissible set, robustness is ranked by the parameter-free worst-case extension of the nominal objective. No uncertainty weight is tuned and the nominal property weights are inherited unchanged.

backward.manifold: mdi_parts = k_blend * nco_oh (exact on the frozen grid)

local_trends.nco_axis: increasing NCO:OH along the same blend
local_trends.composition_axis: increasing parts of the higher-MDI-demand component within the same two-component family at fixed NCO:OH
